name: Eldritch Orb of Annulment
description: If The Searing Exarch is dominant, remove a prefix modifier. If The Eater of Worlds is dominant, remove a suffix modifier.
directions: Right click this item then left click on a magic or rare item with The Searing Exarch or The Eater of Worlds dominance to apply it.
consoleDirections: X to use, then A on a magic or rare item item with The Searing Exarch or The Eater of Worlds dominance to apply it.
